findings.category: numeric_integrity (two contradictory wait times on one screen)
findings.evidence: When the general estimate fails and the order is in preparation, the tracking screen shows TWO different ETAs at once. DOM text: 'EN PRÉPARATION | #0110269555 | Prête dans ~8 min | Prête dans ~15 min | · confirmé par le restaurant'. resume.json sondes S3-suivi-statut-7-estimation-en-panne = ["Prête dans ~8 min","Prête dans ~15 min · confirmé par le restaurant"], versus ["Prête dans ~8 min"] when the estimate works. The 503 itself is the intended probe. The double pill is the defect. Code, from the current lot3 source and present in compiled/funnel.js: the first pill uses the order's own countdown (funnel.jsx:2838-2841, aDecompteReel from trk.wait_low). The fallback pill only checks the general estimate: funnel.jsx:2869 'if (est && est.wait_low != null) return null;'. Since est stays null until a successful fetch (funnel.jsx:2717-2725, which also stays null on a 200 without numbers), the fallback renders as well. Any throttle, 5xx or network blip on /wait-estimate during preparation reproduces it. Severity: protocol P0 for numeric integrity, downgraded to P1 because no money is involved.
findings.fix_hint: In the fallback IIFE also return null when the primary block already rendered a countdown (Number.isFinite(trk.wait_low) && trk.wait_low > 0), or compute one ETA source and render one pill.

findings.evidence: After scrolling the menu, the sticky category chips (Tout / Sandwichs / Burgers…) slide UNDER the two-row app header and cannot be tapped. resume.json sondes S1-onglets-sous-navx-A = {"catSticky":{"top":60,"bottom":116},"navx":{"top":72,"bottom":128},"header":{"top":0,"bottom":129},"elementVisibleAuPoint":"<button class=\"lc-navx-item\"> « Réseaux »","ongletAccessible":false}. Visually, every category capture after selection shows only the filter row, or nothing, under the header; faint chip outlines show through the translucent nav in S-A-onglets. Root cause: styles-mobile.css:343-346 '.lc-cat-sticky { position: sticky; top: var(--nav-h-sm); z-index: 30; }' (60px). styles-v8-vitrine.css:42 '.lc-nav { height: auto; }' added the 56px navx row (--navx-h), so the header is about 129px tall and the chips stick behind it (z 30 < nav 50). To change category, the customer must scroll back to the top of a 39-product list.
findings.fix_hint: top: calc(var(--nav-h-sm) + var(--navx-h)) (plus the safe-area-top padding .lc-nav adds in styles-mobile.css:510), or measure the nav height.

findings.evidence: The header reads '3 commandes au total · 41,50 € dépensés.' (A-53 DOM). The three listed orders are 15,80 € (Prête, not yet paid: pay at counter), 16,80 € (Livrée) and 8,90 € ('Annulée' / 'Aucun point sur une commande annulée'). 15,80 + 16,80 + 8,90 = 41,50, so the cancelled order, and the still-unpaid one, are counted as money spent. Code: orders.jsx:100 'const totalSpent = list.reduce((s, o) => s + o.total, 0);' with no status filter, rendered at orders.jsx:124. The list data in C-r2 is mocked, but the defect is in the reduce, and the page itself ships an 'Annulées' tab, so real histories contain cancelled rows. Severity: protocol P0, downgraded to P1 because it is a display total with no fiscal effect.
findings.fix_hint: Sum only completed/paid rows (exclude status 'cancelled' and, ideally, unpaid in-progress orders), or relabel the figure.

findings.evidence: On the CGV page reached from the app footer, the plain text 'Aller au contenu' is permanently visible above the header (A-68, A-83). findings.state_artifact: C-r2/ (absence): no 'Mise à jour nécessaire' state in A, SE1, SE3 or AND
findings.category: other:audit_integrity (coverage gap on a new screen)
findings.evidence: Round 2 shipped a new blocking screen in lot 20261001lot1 (app-native.js:186-231, afficherMiseAJour: role=alertdialog, title 'Mise à jour nécessaire', '#FF5A1F' button or 'Ouvre l'App Store et mets à jour « Le Cayenne »'). It also handles the 422 APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED path (app-native.js:439). C-r2 has no capture of it in any app size ('ls C-r2 | grep -i maj|mise|update' returns nothing). The bench never mocks /api/frontend/app/config, which falls through to helpers-mock-backend.js:39 '{data: []}', so the screen cannot appear. Its 320px layout, safe-area padding and the no-URL fallback have never been visually reviewed. It is covered only by tests-e2e/version-minimale-2026-10-01.spec.js.
findings.fix_hint: Add states: app/config min_version above api.version (with ios_url, without URL) and a 422 APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED on order POST, in SE1/A/AND.

findings.evidence: Every backend call is answered by the bench. helpers-mock-backend.js:16 routes '**://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/**', and any path not explicitly mocked gets 'route.fulfill({ status: 200, ... JSON.stringify({ data: [] }) })' (line 39). In app modes no 4xx/5xx can surface except the two deliberate probes, so the result '0 silent errors / 0 unexpected 4xx-5xx' proves nothing about the real backend. network.json also logs mocked calls under the production host without marking them, e.g. A-44-confirmation.network.json '{"url":"https://vps-418872ac.vps.ovh.net/api/frontend/order","method":"POST","status":200}'. These look like production writes but were fulfilled locally (no production call; verified in helpers-mock-backend.js:16-39). The mocked order-history rows also omit queue_number (spec historique()), so the 'Mes commandes → Suivre' path (A-95, S-suivi-*) displays '#0110269556'. That path's O-B6 behaviour is therefore unproven in C-r2 rather than broken.
findings.fix_hint: Make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. 599 plus an instrument entry) for unmocked paths, tag mocked responses in network.json, and add queue_number to the mocked history rows.

findings.evidence: The 'Mes commandes' card shows '#0110269401' (orders.jsx:176 '#{o.id}', where id = order_serial_no at orders.jsx:17). The ticket, tracking and notifications for the same order show the called number 'N°A0042' (A-45, A-48). orders.jsx:24 maps queue but never renders it. Not O-B6, whose scope was ticket, tracking and notifications.

findings.evidence: Verdict on the coverage warning: 'Mes commandes' WAS captured (A-52 top of list and A-53 expanded detail; A-53 DOM lists the 3 orders). A-54 'bas' is pixel-identical to A-51 because both show only the shared site footer. Its guard cannot fail: spec e2e-stores-vague-C-2026-10-01.spec.js:801 "await S('mes-commandes-bas', true, 'bas de Mes commandes')". As a result the 'Livrée' and 'Annulée' cards (where the C-004 total matters) were never imaged, and 'Mes commandes' is not captured at all in SE1, SE3 or AND.
findings.fix_hint: Scroll to the last order card (not the page bottom), guard on its presence, and add Mes commandes to the reduced SE1/AND journey.

findings.category: other:audit_integrity (captures older than the code under review)
findings.evidence: The captures loaded 'compiled/funnel.js?v=20261001lot1' (A-44 DOM), while the site worktree index.html now serves 'compiled/funnel.js?v=20261001lot3' (funnel.jsx modified at 10:34, after the capture at 08:21). lot3 contains B2-R2-01 (funnel.jsx:2385-2387, numeroAffiche), which changes the confirmation sentence from 'Ta commande #0110269401 est envoyée' (as captured) to 'N°A0042'. That sentence is therefore NOT reported as a defect, but the confirmation states need a re-capture. Every code-based finding above (C-002, C-008) was re-checked against the current lot3 source and compiled bundle.
findings.fix_hint: Re-run the C bench on lot3 before closing round 2.

findings.category: other:audit_integrity (instrument false positives and blind spots)
findings.evidence: (a) texte_coupe 'h1 « Suivi de ta commande » (344>1)' on 22 tracking states (A, SE1, SE3 and AND, 5 each, plus 2 probes) is a false positive. The h1 is visually hidden by design (DOM: style="position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; ... clip: rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px)"). (b) The same check scans the menu page behind modal sheets and misses the visible truncation inside them (C-006). (c) Playwright reports env(safe-area-inset-*) = 0. 'Buttons under the status bar or home indicator' therefore cannot be judged from C-r2, although the CSS handles insets (styles-mobile.css:489, 510, 615, 644 and app-native.js:157, 201). That needs the device run (tools/verify-app-device.py) or a simulator.
findings.fix_hint: Skip elements whose clip or size is 1px, scope checks to the topmost dialog when one is open, and add a device or simulator pass for the safe areas.

not_reported_as_open: Payment inside the app: only 'Payer sur place' is offered in every app state (A-41, SE1-18, SE3-18, AND-18). No 'bientôt' (annonces_bientot = 0 in all 221 app entries) and no 'Avis' tab (app navx = Accueil/Menu/Réseaux/Itinéraire): owner rules respected.
Closed-restaurant flow ('À l'ouverture 18:20', 'Prévue pour 18 h 20', 'Préparée à l'ouverture') is expected behaviour.
No precise minutes away from the end of the queue: '~15–20 min' while in queue, '~8 min' only at position_ahead=1. No count of orders ahead is shown anywhere.

Account deletion (guideline 5.1.1): 'SUPPRIMER MON COMPTE' is reachable in Mon compte at all 4 sizes (A-61, SE1-29, SE3-29, AND-29), and the post-deletion message is shown (A-96, SE1-39, SE3-39, AND-39). The privacy policy (legal/privacy.html:133-135, 273-275) covers Apple/Google sign-in and deletion.
Expected console/network errors: A-76 404 and S-suivi-7-estimation-en-panne-503. No other console error or warning in any app state.
No horizontal overflow (debordement_horizontal null everywhere) and no raw i18n keys (libelles_bruts empty).
Fixed items not re-reported: O-B5, O-B6, F-B2, A-001, A-002, A-006, A-008, O-2, O-3, O-4. The '#serial' sentence on the confirmation is covered by B2-R2-01 in lot3 (see C-020).
'Tout 39' showing 29 cards is by design: 24 dishes plus a 5-drink preview with 'Voir toutes →' (screens.jsx:1529-1543); 4+2+6+3+2+2+3+2 = 24.
